_comment: Allow list for `agent-skills check-pinned-models` (also run by `agent-skills sweep`). Keys are repo-relative project paths; `*` applies to every project. A model or endpoint literal pinned anywhere in a project (notebook code cells, .sql, fenced code in markdown, .py) that is not listed here fails the check. Add a value when a new model is adopted; remove it when the model is retired, and the check then lists every file still naming it.
